LynkOmni shell in a browser Draft design

Interactive emulator of the parts every LynkOmni surface is built from (build section 1). Sample data, sandbox partners, test money only. Not reviewed by a designer yet.

LynkOmni
https://app.lynkomni.com/

Try it

Everything here is the shared shell: the header, the navigation that becomes tabs on a phone, the app launcher (grid), the account menu, language and region (globe), "find or do anything" (search), the help panel, notifications, the connection chip and every screen state. Change the size and language and nothing breaks.
